headline: A 2019 Senate resolution would have blocked a proposed U.S. weapons sale to Qatar, but the Senate did not advance it.
what_it_does: The resolution would have disapproved a proposed sale to the government of Qatar of certain weapons, ammunition, and related support services. The sale was described in Transmittal No. 19-14, which was sent to Congress on May 13, 2019. Under this resolution, the sale would have been prohibited.

who_it_affects.how: It would not have been able to buy the weapons, ammunition, and support services covered by the proposed sale.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. defense contractors that would have supplied the items
who_it_affects.how: They would not have received the sales covered by the proposed deal.
